title.narrative: Agriculture Development Rio San Juan Area
Desarrollo Agrcola rea Ro San Juan

description.narrative: TO COMPLEMENT WORKS AT THE SABANETA DAM, AND TO MODERNIZE THE IRRIGATION AND DRAINAGE INFRASTRUCTURE ON 6,000 HECTARES ON THE LEFT SIDE OF THE SAN JUAN RIVER VALLEY. TO PROMOTE AGRICULTURAL RESEARCH AND EXTENSION, TO ELICIT EMVIRONMENT CONSERVATION AND TO SUPPORT THE ORGANIZATION OF WATER USERS AND PRODUCERS IN GENERAL, IN ORDER TO IMPROVE IN-FARM WATER USE, CONTAIN SOIL DEGRADATION AND INCREASE AGRICULTURAL PRODUCTIVITY.
